title: UR Subnet epoch usage statement v2
description: An operator's signed usage for one epoch whose committed ledger header carries an extender component (WHITEPAPER.md section 8.6.4, from E_x, the first epoch of the extender pool amendment), published on its /sn/evidence routes as kind epoch-usage-v2, run <no_id>-<epoch>, in at most 1 MiB. It holds every field of epoch-usage-v1 and the epoch's extender pool. Its total_usage_bytes, which adds all of Z to the provider rows' usage, and its total_users size and audit the operator's demand deposit in the next epoch (WHITEPAPER.md section 7.1). Every other epoch keeps its epoch-usage-v1 statement.

end.description: The epoch's finalized end block. Its number must be greater than start's.

provider_chunks.description: The epoch's provider chunks, which must be those the committed ledger header lists for the epoch.

provider_rows.description: The number of rows in those chunks, eligible or not.

total_usage_bytes.description: The sum of the usage bytes of those rows, eligible or not, plus all of extender_pool_bytes (Z, before the cap).

total_users.description: The operator's attested count of distinct top-level clients with contract usage in the epoch window, as a payout artifact's total_users. It is not independently verified.

intra_platform_bytes.description: Z's intra-platform part: the shares of the operator's registered platform endpoints in the funded contracts that closed in the epoch's earning window, less declared measurement and test traffic. The operator's attestation.

intra_network_bytes.description: Z's intra-network part: the shares on each such contract's origin network. The operator's attestation.

extender_pool_bytes.description: Z, the sum of intra_platform_bytes and intra_network_bytes, before the cap. It must equal the bytes of the epoch's extender component in the committed ledger header.

extender_pool_weight_bytes.description: Z', what Z entered the allocation as: min(Z, the epoch's eligible provider usage), and 0 with no eligible extender. It must equal the sum of the share rows that extender_chunks hold.

extender_pool_contracts.description: The number of contracts behind Z, positive exactly when Z is. The operator's attestation.

extender_pool_payers.description: The number of distinct payer networks behind Z, at most extender_pool_contracts and positive exactly when it is. The operator's attestation.

extender_census.description: The census chunks, in order, which must be those the committed ledger header lists for the epoch's extender component: 98-byte rows, one per extender of the operator known in the epoch, eligible or not. [] for a census with no rows.

extender_units.description: M, the units that hold at least one eligible census row, as counted from the census chunks.

eligible_extenders.description: N, the eligible census rows, as counted from the census chunks. extender_units is positive exactly when it is, and at most it.

extender_chunks.description: The share-row chunks, in order, which must be those the committed ledger header lists for the epoch's extender component: 57-byte rows like provider rows. [] exactly when extender_pool_weight_bytes is 0.

signer.description: The address of the operator's artifact key.

signature.description: The artifact key's secp256k1 signature, with a recovery id of 0 or 1, over the SHA-256 of the statement without this field, encoded as Go's encoding/json writes it: compact, with the fields in the order listed here.
